scope: Windows native Herdr startup and reconnect control-path optimization
changes: Validate all namespace slots from one fresh pane inventory per pass.
Reuse the current live mount result during session binding, while retaining fresh observations after external mutations.
Skip writes when namespace and agent ledgers are unchanged; changed state still follows the existing durable transaction path.
limits: Offline Herdr protocol fixture with scripted providers; these are control-flow timings, not full live Pi/Claude/Codex startup timings.
Five reconnect samples and one cold-start sample per binary; no p95 or broad workload speedup claim.
The original seventy-second Pi extension initialization issue was not reproduced or attributed.
No real model requests or global provider sessions were created.
Ordinary CLI and core admission baseline were measured; this patch changes Herdr orchestration only.
